static: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished app icon for SwarmLens, a multi-agent observability tool. Primary concept: ants moving together on a leaf, observed through a magnifying glass. Draw a bold, elegant mint/emerald leaf that runs from lower left to upper right, with one simple midrib and only two subtle veins. Three clearly recognizable deep-navy ants travel along the leaf; each has three body segments, six short legs and two antennae, with clean graphic silhouettes. A large ivory/silver magnifying lens overlaps the middle/right part of the leaf, its short chunky handle angled toward lower right; the ant under the glass is visibly larger. Use a refined flat-vector illustration style, solid shapes, rounded edges and restrained soft shading, not a photorealistic image or a busy scene. Match the project's palette: near-black navy #101D28, emerald #14977E, mint #9BE6C7, warm ivory #F3F7EF. Center the complete mark on a uniform near-black navy #101D28 square background, generous 12% safe margin, no border, no text, no letters, no watermark. The leaf silhouette and magnifier must read at 48 pixels. Icon should feel like a precise software product brand rather than a children's mascot. Output one square image, not a presentation sheet.
animation: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: animation sprite sheet for the SwarmLens app icon. Edit target: the attached SwarmLens leaf, ants and magnifying glass icon. Create ONE square sprite sheet containing EXACTLY 16 frames in a strict 4-column by 4-row grid, read left to right, top to bottom, equal square cells. No gutters, borders, labels or text. Every cell is a complete icon on the same uniform navy #101D28 background. Preserve the reference design, leaf contour, veins, mint/emerald colors, magnifying lens ring, handle, shadows, illumination and exact framing in EVERY cell; they are entirely stationary and identical. The ONLY moving objects are the three ants. Animate a seamless 16-frame walking cycle: the ants walk steadily northeast along the leaf's central vein, with clear alternating leg motion, two small ants approaching the lens and one magnified ant underneath it. Advance them by small equal amounts frame to frame; the procession is periodic so frame16 naturally leads back to frame1 without a jump. Keep the magnified ant in the lens, let it take a small looping walk, do not rotate the leaf or move the glass. Each frame must align perfectly at exactly the same scale, position and safe margins. Keep the polished restrained shading and graphic silhouettes of the reference. Square high resolution 2048x2048 output preferred, so each frame is 512x512. This is production animation artwork, not a mockup. Do not show a contact sheet with labels.
assembly: FFmpeg: split the generated 4×4 sprite sheet into 16 frames, 10 fps, 1.6-second infinite GIF loop. PNG exports resized with Lanczos.
